da-false-claim.evidence: categorical-neutrality-saturated-shells.md:56-66 'Trivial action of the full-twist on Φ_n therefore constrains the partitions ... to those with content sum zero — the self-conjugate partitions λ=λ′ on Young's lattice.'
da-false-claim.notes: The block equates 'content sum c(λ)=0' with 'self-conjugate λ=λ′'. The forward direction (self-conjugate ⇒ content sum 0) is true, but the CONVERSE asserted here is false: there exist content-sum-zero partitions that are not self-conjugate. Verified by direct enumeration — e.g. (6,3,2,2,2)⊢15, (5,5,2,1,1,1)⊢15, (7,2,2,2,2,1)⊢16, (6,4,4,3,3)⊢20 all have c(λ)=0 yet λ≠λ′. Critically this fails AT magic n: n=20 (a magic number) has counterexamples, and n=82,126 (also magic, matrix-evaluation unavailable) lie well inside the regime where the converse breaks. So 'full-twist acts trivially ⇒ supported on self-conjugate partitions' is mathematically incorrect; trivial full-twist action only forces content-sum-zero support, a strictly larger set. The whole 'self-conjugate support' reformulation (the block's central structural claim) rests on this false equivalence.

da-vacuous.notes: The conjecture (Δ_n²·Φ_n=Φ_n at magic n) is a substantive selection rule, and the Lean class SaturatedShellConjecture carries content-bearing fields (neutrality_left/right are real equalities, not True). Conditional theorems (fullTwist_iter_neutral etc.) genuinely derive from the class hypotheses. Not vacuous.

da-circular.evidence: categorical-neutrality-saturated-shells.md:1-2,89-101 the magic set 𝔐={2,8,20,28,50,82,126} is taken as input and 'saturation' is then explained as full-twist neutrality
da-circular.notes: The proposition asserts neutrality holds 'for every n∈𝔐' where 𝔐 is the empirically-observed magic set — i.e. the magic numbers are an input, and the categorical condition is asserted to coincide with them rather than derived to produce them. The downstream cone (md:133-138) lists prop:magic-numbers-from-q as anticipated to FOLLOW, so the magic numbers are simultaneously assumed (in the statement) and claimed as a consequence elsewhere. This is a mild circularity risk; flagged as conjectural so warn, but the 'replacing the ad hoc shell-model selection rule' framing (md:71-72) overstates how much is derived vs assumed.

da-overclaim.evidence: categorical-neutrality-saturated-shells.md:64-66 'constrains the partitions that appear ... to those with content sum zero — the self-conjugate partitions' and :86-87 'Saturation at n∈{50,82,126} then follows without resort to matrices.'
da-overclaim.notes: Two coupled overclaims. (1) The self-conjugate reformulation is presented as equivalent to content-sum-zero support (it is strictly stronger — see da-false-claim), so the 'homological reformulation' verifies a NARROWER condition than full-twist neutrality actually implies; the claimed equivalence overstates the structural content. (2) 'Saturation at {50,82,126} then follows without resort to matrices' overclaims: content-sum-zero arithmetic does NOT pin self-conjugate support at those n (the two sets differ there), so the matrix-free argument does not establish the asserted self-conjugate-support saturation. The numerical verification is only at n=2,8,20 (md:80-82); extending to 50,82,126 'by content-sum arithmetic' is asserted, not demonstrated, and rests on the false equivalence.

da-hidden-dof.notes: No numerical fit constants; the magic set is a stated input, not a hidden parameter, and the content-sum eigenvalue q^{c(λ)} is a standard Hecke central-character fact (cited geckpfeiffer2000, mathas1999).

da-non-sequitur.evidence: categorical-neutrality-saturated-shells.md:62-66 'Trivial action of the full-twist on Φ_n therefore constrains the partitions ... to those with content sum zero — the self-conjugate partitions λ=λ′'
da-non-sequitur.notes: The 'therefore ... the self-conjugate partitions' is a non-sequitur: from 'full-twist acts trivially ⇒ Φ_n supported on content-sum-zero partitions' the conclusion 'supported on self-conjugate partitions' does not follow, because content-sum-zero ⊋ self-conjugate (e.g. (6,3,2,2,2)⊢15). The step silently substitutes the smaller set for the larger, with the missing (false) lemma 'c(λ)=0 ⇔ λ=λ′'. The argument is valid only up to 'content-sum-zero support'; the self-conjugate strengthening is unjustified.

da-physical-implausibility.evidence: categorical-neutrality-saturated-shells.md:98-101 'A non-trivial full-twist action would propagate unbounded ribbon/framing flux through the brane tower; finite observable mass forces global topological neutrality at saturation.'
da-physical-implausibility.notes: The physical argument 'finite mass ⇒ full-twist neutrality' is a heuristic, not a controlled bound: a non-trivial framing scalar q^{c(λ)} is a phase/unit-modulus factor at root of unity, so it need not produce 'unbounded flux' or infinite mass — the leap from 'non-trivial action' to 'unbounded flux' to 'forces neutrality' is physically loose. A nuclear-structure expert would also note the seven magic numbers arise from spin-orbit shell structure, and asserting they are exactly the content-sum-zero/self-conjugate levels is a strong claim not borne out past n=20 here. Conjectural framing softens this to warn.

da-referee-verdict.notes: verdict: reject-as-stated / major-revision required. referee_argument: The proposition's central structural claim is built on a false partition-theoretic equivalence. The block argues full-twist neutrality ⇒ Φ_n supported on self-conjugate partitions, via 'content sum zero = self-conjugate' (md:62-66). That equivalence is FALSE: content-sum-zero ⊋ self-conjugate, with explicit counterexamples at n=15,16,19,20 (e.g. (6,3,2,2,2)⊢15, (6,4,4,3,3)⊢20) — and crucially it fails AT magic n=20 and throughout the n=82,126 regime where the block claims 'saturation follows without matrices' (md:86-87). So (a) the self-conjugate reformulation is a strict over-strengthening of what neutrality actually implies (da-false-claim/da-non-sequitur, critical/major), and (b) the matrix-free extension to {50,82,126} is unsupported (da-overclaim). The Lean class is sound but encodes only the abstract monoid fixed-point, not the partition claim, so it does not catch the error. Empirical support reaches only n=2,8,20. Required fix: either weaken the structural claim to 'content-sum-zero support' (correct) and drop the self-conjugate identification, or prove the additional constraint that forces self-conjugacy at the magic levels; revalidate the {50,82,126} extension.
